utterances.speaker: Mina

utterances.text: Mara: Let’s prioritize tools and a small intake table first, then we can sort supplies as people arrive. I can help set that up on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Mara — tools and an intake table are our first priorities. I’ll make sure we have everything ready at the community center on Sunday.

utterances.text: Tess: Oh, we’re still collecting supplies for the repair drive, and every little bit helps. If you’ve got anything spare, I’d be glad to pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and send folks your way for the repair drive. If you want, I can also share the list of supplies people can bring.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be wonderful, Quinn — please do share the supplies list, and thanks for sending folks my way!
